author: Huawei
description:
From the heights of Mount Everest to the roar of a stadium, what keeps our world connected?
 
Our expectations for connectivity have changed enormously. Signals of Change, "The Innovations That Connected the World," explores how wireless technology has evolved to meet them.
 
Produced by Huawei in collaboration with CNN International's brand studio Create, Signals of Change brings stories of connectivity to life.
 
Watch the trailer now. #Huawei #Antennas #InnovateForImpact
title: Signals of Change: The Innovations That Connected the World
